records.title: DANIEL ROBERT HUNZIKER - von bartha
records.description: Argovian artist Daniel Robert Hunziker (CH) has a special relationship to space, and space-relevant architectural practices are an integral part of his work. He integrates architecture into his work, which in turn incorporates the work within a specific location. Hunziker uses spatial stagings and constructions to make visible fractions of reality and project them outwards.
